server.title: Server
server.description: The server package folder, relative to the workspace folder or using ${workspaceFolder}. Leave empty to use the folder's only server.

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: The config and passwords the server uses.

applyMigrations.title: Apply migrations
applyMigrations.description: Apply pending database migrations when the server starts.

watch.title: Hot reload
watch.description: Generate code and reload the server when files change. Requires Serverpod 4.

docker.title: Docker services
docker.description: Start the Docker Compose services. Leave unset to let Serverpod decide from the database config. Requires Serverpod 4.

launchFlutterApps.title: Launch Flutter apps
launchFlutterApps.description: Launch the companion Flutter apps marked auto_launch. Requires Serverpod 4.

serverArgs.title: Server arguments
serverArgs.description: Extra arguments for the server's bin/main.dart. Enter one argument per line.
